summary: Brineura is not independently replicated; both supporting studies share a senior author
rationale: The open-label extension (Lancet Neurol 2024;23(1):60-70) and the real-world cohort (Front Neurol 2025;16:1516026) share a senior author and group (Schulz, Hamburg). Two papers from one group are not an independent replication, and the L5 rung rested on that word. Record demoted to L4 and marked disputed on 2026-07-27.
